_comment: Deterministic rung-pick probes for the row-6 decision rung (issue #244 AC 4c).
Attempts: the three refinement probes were first submitted by a builder step whose
submitter died (step-builder-244-1794920362/1794943055); those jobs sat pending ~3 h
and were never launched, so they were resubmitted as attempt 2 on an idle fleet and
all three passed. The known-bad viability probe ran once, attempt 1.
Decision from these measurements: rung RREF 71k. Measured margin-equivalents
(I_nom 203.2 uA from the S2 units' vte_avg / RTE 2k, I_rung from each probe):
0.152 / 0.144 / 0.136 V (all sustain the 0.1 V criterion). 71k is the strongest
starvation whose nominal equivalent still clears the 3.0 floor, so a sustaining die
certifies >= 3.0 and the conservative-fail band (thresholds the rung cannot resolve)
is the narrowest; 69k (2.980 < 3.0) would grade the campaign yield ~0 by estimator
construction. See ../records/ (the AC 4c run record) for the full argument.
